# Threat Model

Use Security Review Framework v2 to produce a security threat model.

## Inputs

Use visible code, documentation, manifests, diagrams, configuration, and repository structure. Do not invent systems or endpoints.

## Required Sections

- System overview
- Assets
- Data classification
- Actors and roles
- Entry points
- Trust boundaries
- Privilege boundaries
- Data flows
- External dependencies
- Abuse cases
- STRIDE threats
- Existing controls
- Missing or uncertain controls
- Recommended mitigations

## STRIDE Coverage

Evaluate:

- Spoofing
- Tampering
- Repudiation
- Information disclosure
- Denial of service
- Elevation of privilege

## Output

Return a concise model plus prioritized security questions. Mark assumptions explicitly and separate confirmed facts from inferences.
